nodes.label: main
nodes.desc: Parses flags, creates the API server client with backoff, creates the fake certificate, then starts the controller

nodes.label: NewNGINXController
nodes.desc: Constructs the NGINXController: store, task queue bound to syncIngress, template writer, admission server

nodes.label: Start
nodes.desc: Runs the store, leader election, the nginx child process and the select loop over ngxErrCh and store events

nodes.label: NewTaskQueue
nodes.desc: Rate-limited work queue whose single consumer is syncIngress, coalescing bursts of events

nodes.label: k8sStore.Run
nodes.desc: Entry point that launches every informer and keeps the in-memory cache warm

nodes.label: Informer.Run
nodes.desc: Starts Secret, EndpointSlice, Service, ConfigMap, Namespace and Ingress informers in parallel

nodes.label: ListIngresses
nodes.desc: Returns every cached Ingress the controller owns, with annotations already parsed

nodes.label: syncIngress
nodes.desc: The heart of the sync flow: list, build model, hash-compare, reload or dynamically update

nodes.label: getConfiguration
nodes.desc: Maps the Ingress list onto backends, servers and a complete ingress.Configuration

nodes.label: getBackendServers
nodes.desc: Walks rules and paths, merging hosts into servers and paths into backends

nodes.label: createUpstreams
nodes.desc: Resolves each backend Service to a named upstream with endpoints from EndpointSlices

nodes.label: createServers
nodes.desc: Builds per-host server blocks including TLS certificates and the catch-all server

nodes.label: config hash
nodes.desc: hashstructure.Hash fingerprints the desired config; equality with runningConfig skips the reload

nodes.label: IsDynamicConfigurationEnough
nodes.desc: Decides whether Lua-driven endpoint updates suffice or a full nginx reload is required

nodes.label: OnUpdate
nodes.desc: Renders, tests and writes nginx.conf then issues nginx -s reload; tracks worker reloads

nodes.label: generateTemplate
nodes.desc: Tunes hash sizes and FD limits, assembles TemplateConfig and executes the Go template

nodes.label: TemplateConfig
nodes.desc: The struct handed to the template: servers, backends, TCP/UDP endpoints and global ConfigMap settings

nodes.label: nginx.tmpl
nodes.desc: The master Go template that emits the http block, per-host server blocks and stream config

nodes.label: testTemplate
nodes.desc: Runs nginx -t against the generated config in a temp file; a bad template never reaches the live file

nodes.label: createLuaConfig
nodes.desc: Writes the Lua data file that configureDynamically later PATCHes without reloading

nodes.label: configureDynamically
nodes.desc: POSTs new backends as JSON to the Lua endpoint with exponential-backoff retries

nodes.label: Check
nodes.desc: Healthz checker pinging the nginx status endpoint and is-dynamic-lb-initialized

nodes.label: setupLeaderElection
nodes.desc: client-go leaderelection wrapper: one replica leads, others idle until the lease lapses

nodes.label: LeaseLock
nodes.desc: Coordination-v1 Lease named by ElectionID; TTL splits into renew deadline and retry period

nodes.label: NewStatusSyncer
nodes.desc: Builds the status updater from the publish Service so leaders know which addresses to publish

nodes.label: statusSync.Run
nodes.desc: Leader-only queue that keeps Ingress status in sync with the publish Service

nodes.label: updateStatus
nodes.desc: Writes LoadBalancer IPs into every owned Ingress, standardizing and deduplicating addresses

nodes.label: HandleAdmission
nodes.desc: Decodes AdmissionReview v1 requests and answers allow or deny based on CheckIngress

nodes.label: ServeHTTP
nodes.desc: TLS HTTP handler with a body-size cap that deserializes AdmissionReviews and encodes responses

nodes.label: CheckIngress
nodes.desc: Dry-runs the full model build and template render for one Ingress; nginx -t disabled after CVE-2025-1974

nodes.label: CheckWarning
nodes.desc: Collects non-fatal warnings, such as deprecated annotations, attached to the admission response
